notes: Napoleon documentary, chapter 5 (Europe and Russia): 9 paintings x 4 seeds, 16:9, style ghm_painterly_v2. Client picks; nothing is final before approval.

shots.framing: wide river view, a large wooden raft with a classical pavilion in the middle of a broad river, two small boats approaching from either bank, troops lining both shores
shots.scene: the meeting of Napoleon and Tsar Alexander I on the raft on the Niemen at Tilsit, 25 June 1807, pavilion decorated with the letters N and A, French and Russian guards on the banks
shots.lighting: bright summer morning, reflections on calm water

shots.framing: wide harbour quay, French customs officers and soldiers burning piles of confiscated bales and crates on the left, merchants watching, ships moored behind
shots.scene: the Continental System, about 1810, seized British goods (cotton, sugar, coffee) burned on a quay in a northern European port, gendarmes and townspeople
shots.lighting: overcast daylight, orange fire glow and dark smoke

shots.framing: wide shot in a rocky mountain pass, Spanish guerrillas firing from boulders on both sides, a French supply convoy with wagons trapped on the road below
shots.scene: the Peninsular War, about 1809, guerrilleros in brown cloaks and wide hats, French dragoons in brass helmets, a whitewashed village on a far hill
shots.lighting: harsh Spanish sun, dark shadows, dust and smoke
shots.negative_extra: text, letters, watermark, close-up wounds, blood, gore

shots.framing: epic wide plain, a grand battery of French guns firing in a long line from the left foreground, smoke rolling across the field, columns advancing beyond
shots.scene: the Battle of Wagram, July 1809, the Marchfeld plain near Vienna, French artillery of the Guard, Austrian lines and burning villages on the horizon
shots.lighting: hot summer afternoon, sun glare through smoke

shots.framing: medium-wide interior, the Emperor standing on the left beside a young fair-haired empress holding an infant in white lace, courtiers bowing
shots.scene: the Tuileries palace, 1811, Empress Marie-Louise with the newborn King of Rome, Napoleon in the uniform of a colonel of the Guard grenadiers, gilded salon
shots.lighting: soft warm interior light, gilded reflections

shots.framing: wide elevated view of a broad river crossed by three pontoon bridges, endless columns of infantry, cavalry and wagons streaming across from left to right
shots.scene: the Grande Armee crossing the Niemen near Kovno, 24 June 1812, uniforms of many nations, lancers, artillery, the Emperor's tent on a hill
shots.lighting: early summer morning, bright sun, dust over the far bank

shots.framing: wide shot along a dusty road through flat Russian country, exhausted soldiers marching from the right toward the left, a dead horse and an abandoned cart at the roadside
shots.scene: the Grande Armee on the march in Russia, July-August 1812, stragglers, a burning village on the horizon, wheat fields and birch groves
shots.lighting: oppressive summer heat haze, white sky, dust
shots.negative_extra: text, letters, watermark, close-up wounds, blood, gore

shots.framing: wide shot of a fortified earthwork redoubt on a hill, French cuirassiers and infantry storming it from the left, Russian gunners in dark green defending
shots.scene: the Battle of Borodino, 7 September 1812, the Raevsky redoubt, broken gabions, smoke covering the field, Russian and French standards
shots.negative_extra: text, letters, watermark, close-up wounds, blood, gore

shots.framing: wide night view from the Kremlin walls, a small figure in a grey greatcoat and bicorne seen from behind on the right, watching a city in flames
shots.scene: Moscow burning, September 1812, onion domes and church towers silhouetted against fire, embers in the air, Guard grenadiers on the walls
shots.lighting: night lit by an enormous orange fire, embers, smoke
